mechanics: Plague tokens (class token, yellow hand on a black pentagon): not a condition, no innate effect, not removable by enemies, supply of 12 (a 13th removes a previously placed one), max 3 per enemy. Given by attacks/abilities (Comorbid Sting, Biting Gnats, Festering Sores, Path of the Pox, Spread the Plague, Cloying Miasma, Rabid Bite, Wilt and Wither, Compounding Infection, Mass Extinction, Convert the Flock, Disease Vector, Unwilling Sacrifice, Accelerated End)

Effects scaling with Plague count: damage per Plague to each enemy (Virulent Strain bottom 1, Rot Maggots bottom 1 per turn, Wilt and Wither top 1, Disease Vector bottom 2, Unwilling Sacrifice top 2 on one enemy), +1 Attack per Plague (Wretched Yield, Crippling Malady), heal per Plague (Wretched Yield), enemy -1/-2 Attack per Plague (Blistering Buboes, Creeping Lethargy), enemy -1 Move per Plague (Festering Sores)

Targeting by Plague: 'all enemies (at any range) that have Plague' and '1/2 enemies at any range that has Plague' (Vile Pestilence, Biting Gnats, Delirium's Danse, Crippling Malady, Succumb to the Gift, Mass Extinction, Disease Vector)
Plague spreading: chain (Path of the Pox bottom), on death (Festering Sores top), remove-to-spread (Unwilling Sacrifice top)

Giving Poison to an ally as an optional cost (only to an ally without Poison, per the mat) for a bonus: Comorbid Sting bottom, Delirium's Danse top, Gift of Rot bottom, Nightmarish Affliction top and bottom, Tainted Offering top

Effects on allies that have Poison: grants (Contagious Corpse Shield, Xorn's Embrace attack+heal), Strengthen/Bless/Ward/Heal targeting all allies with Poison (Sickening Strength, Succumb to the Gift, Gift of Rot, Tainted Offering), +1 Attack (Compounding Infection, Virulent Strain), damage negation (Creeping Lethargy), heal that ignores and keeps Poison (Gift of Rot, Tainted Offering, Xorn's Embrace), forced Poison on allies (Rot Maggots top, Accelerated End bottom hits all adjacent figures)
Control enemies: Spread the Plague top, Rabid Bite top (Strengthen then forced Move toward a monster without Plague, then Attack), Convert the Flock top (all normal and elite with Plague)

Designate an enemy (Accelerated End bottom), create a damage+Poison trap on kill (Succumb to the Gift), shuffle a Curse into the monster deck on kill (Contagious Corpse), double damage to Plague enemies (Wilt and Wither), on-Curse-draw trigger (Compounding Infection), teleport on kill (Convert the Flock), recover a level 1 card (Tainted Offering), out-of-turn card play for allies at a damage cost (Sickening Strength), attack from an ally's hex (Tainted Offering)
Conditions used: Poison, Wound, Muddle, Stun, Immobilize, Disarm, Curse; positive: Strengthen, Bless, Ward, advantage. No elements on any card. No summons. No area diagrams
unclear: Abilities with 'target all' and no printed range (Biting Gnats top Muddle and bottom Poison+Muddle, Delirium's Danse bottom Stun, Crippling Malady bottom Immobilize, Disease Vector top Poison, Creeping Lethargy top Heal 1): any range, or range 1? Rules question; the attacks that mean any range say 'at any range'
Biting Gnats bottom and Creeping Lethargy top say only 'all' (no 'enemies'/'allies'); read by ability type (negative = enemies, heal = allies), rules question

Text abilities with no range (Path of the Pox top, Blistering Buboes top, Unwilling Sacrifice top, Spread the Plague top, Rabid Bite top Strengthen, Convert the Flock top and bottom, Accelerated End bottom designate, Xorn's Embrace bottom): whether range / line of sight applies is a rules question
Virulent Strain top: 'one of your allies that has Poison' — whether it is one chosen ally or any poisoned ally's attacks use the slots is a wording question
Mass Extinction top: after a kill adds +1 Target, whether the next target must still be an enemy with Plague and whether each kill adds again (rules question)

Festering Sores top and Compounding Infection top: persistent with no slots and no lost icon; they end when discarded by their own trigger, otherwise (if never triggered) presumably at the end of the scenario (rules question)
